name: Carma Structured Data and GEO Audit
author: carmainside

sections.description:
Carma Structured Data and GEO Audit adds a neutral machine-readable information layer to WordPress websites. Developed by Carma Inside GmbH. The plugin does not change the visible website layout. It focuses on structured website profile data, JSON-LD output, endpoint consistency, external source completeness and a simple GEO checklist for maintained website information.

This free plugin is intentionally lightweight. It focuses on a structured website profile, Schema.org output, external source consistency and a simple GEO audit inside the WordPress admin area, rather than being only a standalone llms.txt generator. It does not include visitor monitoring, report exports, multi-location management, agency features or license management.

Features

  • Optional llms.txt support for concise machine-readable website guidance
  • ai-profile.json with website and organization profile data
  • ai-services.json with maintained services or offerings
  • ai-faq.json with curated questions and answers
  • REST endpoints under /wp-json/carma-geo/v1/
  • JSON-LD / Schema.org output for structured data
  • Simple GEO audit inside the WordPress admin area
  • Neutral input fields without industry-specific sample content
  • robots.txt hints for machine-readable endpoints
  • FAQ suggestions based on the entered website data

Privacy

Carma Structured Data and GEO Audit does not store visitor logs and does not include AI traffic monitoring. Website profile data is stored locally in the WordPress database. This version does not send this data to external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file in WordPress under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Carma GEO menu item in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Maintain the website profile, services, target audiences, FAQ entries and external sources.
  5. Save the settings and review the machine-readable endpoints.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change the visible website design?

No. The plugin adds structured data and machine-readable endpoints without changing the visible website layout.

Does the plugin guarantee mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI?

No. The plugin improves the technical and structural conditions for machine-readable website information. Mentions by AI systems cannot be guaranteed.

Does this plugin include monitoring or reports?

No. This plugin focuses on structured website data, machine-readable endpoints and basic GEO checks.

Can this plugin be used on any website?

Yes. The plugin uses neutral input fields and is not limited to a specific industry.
